title: DIET: Deletion-response Expert Trimming for Video Diffusion Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2609.37829v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Video diffusion transformers (DiTs) increasingly adopt mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures to reduce active computation, but their full expert storage remains costly. Existing one-shot pruning criteria mainly rely on static activation or routing statistics and cannot capture layer-level re-routing after expert deletion. We introduce DIET, a training-free expert pruning framework based on deletion responses. A single all-expert calibration pass records expert outputs and router states for matched conditional and unconditional tokens. Candidate deletions are then replayed from cached tensors, requiring no additional model forward passes. The resulting deletion-response signatures characterize each expert by the changes induced when it is removed. translated_title: DIET：面向视频扩散Transformer的删除响应专家剪枝方法
translated_abstract: 视频扩散Transformer（DiT）越来越多地采用混合专家架构来减少活跃计算量，但其完整的专家存储成本依然高昂。现有的一次性剪枝准则主要依赖静态激活或路由统计信息，无法捕捉专家删除后的层级层面重新路由。我们提出了DIET，一种基于删除响应的无训练专家剪枝框架。通过单次全专家校准过程，记录条件token与无条件token相匹配时的专家输出和路由器状态。候选删除随后从缓存张量中重放，无需额外的模型前向传播。由此产生的删除响应特征通过删除某专家时引起的变化来刻画该专家。DIET通过最小化总体多样性损失（ODL）来选择保留的专家，该损失可保持特征空间中的方向覆盖，并结合层内局部搜索与层间重新（组合）…
tldr: 提出了DIET——一种面向视频扩散Transformer的无训练专家剪枝框架，利用删除响应特征与总体多样性损失（ODL）来选择保留专家，在无需额外前向传播的情况下大幅降低MoE架构的专家存储成本。
en_tdlr: DIET is a training-free expert pruning framework for video diffusion transformers that characterizes experts by deletion-response signatures and selects retained experts via Overall Diversity Loss, trimming costly MoE expert storage without extra forward passes.
